description: External benchmark basis for the alpha construction core kitchen fixture.

metrics.explanation: Generated carcass-scope area is compared with the current golden case only; this is not a universal geometry claim.
Back construction mode is provisional and the generated back scope is limited to the alpha tall-cabinet rule.
Only emitted per-part visible sides are aggregated; production edge exposure policy is not represented.
Only explicit facade dimensions are included; missing dimensions are not synthesized.

notes: Targets are diagnostic reference values and do not calibrate generated geometry.
The facade target is a reference variant and is not a reason to synthesize missing dimensions.
